rejection_summary.title: The Resort
rejection_summary.reason: The eight-episode TVMaze guide shows that Emma, Noah and Baltasar pursue a real disappearance inquiry in successive episodes, culminating in a time-displaced cave explanation. However, a substantive critic who screened the complete season finds that the inquiry often consists of extended exposition, retrospective tangents and marital/grief material rather than proportionate new explanations; the central mechanism and disappearance answer are heavily deferred until the finale. Other criticism praises the performances and strangeness, but the disagreement makes whole-season revelation cadence and explanatory payoff too uncertain for a confident complete-DNA acceptance. Excluded qualitatively, not on its premise or genre label.

rejection_summary.title: The Jacket
rejection_summary.reason: A wrongfully confined veteran's experimental sensory-deprivation treatment produces apparent future visits and a question about his impending death. Complete-film synopsis and substantive criticism indicate that prolonged institutional abuse, personal suffering and the relationship with Jackie share the runtime with the time puzzle; its temporal mechanism remains speculative and several developments rely on coincidence or unexplained causation. The final altered future provides an emotional outcome rather than a rigorously discovered explanation of the phenomenon, so the progressive mystery payoff is insufficiently secure for complete DNA measurement.
